verdict.rationale: The request-changes docs name 'Pre-Merge Checks' as something CodeRabbit tracks when it blocks or approves PRs, and the evidence shows this decision can block a PR. Path instructions let you write plain-language guidance, such as test-coverage requirements or documentation rules, that applies during automatic reviews on every PR. However, no evidence documents how users define custom pass/fail pre-merge checks in natural language, so this rests on stitching review guidance to a gate whose details are thin. Missing for 10: a dedicated doc on defining custom plain-language pre-merge checks, evidence that such checks report pass/fail per PR, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
